about: Water records the San Diego Water Board's table of USIBWC spill and transboundary flow events (source ca-sd-regional-board-ibwc-spills, read 2026-11-15, 16 rows) would place its reports on, none of which is on file: no California record in data/waters-*.json is named Tijuana River, Tijuana River Estuary, Smuggler's Gulch, Goat Canyon, Stewart's Drain, Silva Drain or Canyon del Sol. Proposed only; nothing here is a water record. The feed (pipeline/ingest/ca_sd_tijuana_table.py) places a report on a California record of the name it gives (record name or alias) whose box meets the Tijuana River valley (-117.16, 32.50, -116.95, 32.62), so a record built under any slug with that name is picked up on the next run. The Pacific Ocean record (pacific-ocean-ca) exists; no row names it. The table gives no coordinates: the reference points are the USGS names service's (for the three drains, the permit's monitoring stations, 2026-11-16), for building the records, never a report's point. Names and identifiers were looked up on 2026-11-15 in the National Map's NHD and geographic names services and the Census TIGERweb hydrography.

rows.name: Tijuana River
rows.nhd: NHD high resolution flowlines of GNIS 255756 'Tijuana River' (34 flowlines meet the valley box, 20.6 km, part in Mexico; reach codes 18070305...), cut to California as the other NHD records are
rows.reference_points_from: USGS GNIS 255756, Streams (Mouth) layer of the National Map's geographic names service (mouth and source points as listed)
rows.build: python -m ingest.waters_from_nhd --names research/ca/tijuana-water-records-proposed.json --state CA (one NHD water of this name in CA)
rows.basis: the table's row of Tijuana River Transboundary Flow Events names the river as its discharge location; the canyons below drain to it or to its estuary

rows.name: Tijuana River Estuary
rows.nhd: no named NHD estuary or waterbody: NHD gives only unnamed marsh (FType 466) and pond polygons around the mouth, the river's own flowlines and Oneonta Slough (GNIS 246917, the estuary's northern arm, 32.56534, -117.13115); 2026-11-16: no GNIS feature named Tijuana River Estuary or Tijuana Slough in the valley (geonames layers); the Census TIGER/Line area water at the mouth is the Tijuana River polygon (OID 11033199298433) and the Pacific Ocean only
rows.reference_points_from: USGS GNIS 246917 'Oneonta Slough' (Other Hydrographic Features layer)
rows.build: not built (2026-11-16): no public outline names the estuary in a form the writer takes; NOAA's research reserve boundary (not read) is a management boundary, not a water outline, and the NHD marsh polygons at the mouth are unnamed. The permit's station TRV-7, 'Tijuana River Mouth; Saline or brackish/estuarine downstream station', 32°33.1362'N 117°7.5677'W (Order No. R9-2021-0001, Table E-1, page E-9), marks the mouth only.
rows.basis: no table row names the estuary; it is needed for a modeled path from the river and the canyons to the sea

rows.name: Smuggler's Gulch
rows.nhd: GNIS 249613 'Smuggler Gulch' is a Valley (landform) feature; no NHD flowline carries the name in the valley
rows.reference_points_from: USGS GNIS 249613, Landforms layer of the National Map's geographic names service
rows.build: a hand record: the unnamed NHD flowline down the gulch from the border to the Tijuana River, named from GNIS 249613
rows.basis: the table's discharge location for five rows (Spill Events and dry weather Canyon Collector Transboundary Flow Events)

rows.name: Goat Canyon
rows.nhd: GNIS 242756 'Goat Canyon' is a Valley (landform) feature; no NHD flowline carries the name in the valley
rows.reference_points_from: USGS GNIS 242756, Landforms layer of the National Map's geographic names service
rows.build: a hand record: the unnamed NHD flowline down the canyon from the border to the estuary, named from GNIS 242756
rows.basis: the table's discharge location for four rows (two at the Goat Canyon Pump Station)

rows.name: Stewart's Drain
rows.nhd: no GNIS or NHD feature of this name in the valley box (queried 2026-11-15); no USGS NHD high-resolution flowline passes the station (nearest: the Tijuana River, 189 m; queried 2026-11-16); no Census TIGER/Line water within 190 m. OpenStreetMap has an unnamed stream 11 m from the station (ways 241997755, 356062067, 356062068), not used: an unnamed web-map line is not a cited location.
rows.reference_points_from: San Diego Regional Water Quality Control Board, Order No. R9-2021-0001 (NPDES No. CA0108928), waste discharge requirements for the United States Section of the International Boundary and Water Commission, South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant (adopted May 12, 2021), Attachment E (Monitoring and Reporting Program), Table E-1 Monitoring Station Locations, pages E-8 and E-9, https://www.waterboards.ca.gov/sandiego/board_decisions/adopted_orders/2021/R9-2021-0001.pdf, read 2026-11-16. The table's note 2: the latitudes and longitudes are approximate for administrative purposes. Station TRV-2, as published: "Stewart's Drain; Freshwater canyon collector station; Latitude: 32°32.4282'N; Longitude: 117°3.4698'W" (degrees and decimal minutes; the point here is that value in decimal degrees, rounded to five places)
rows.build: not built (2026-11-16): the permit gives a monitoring station point only (the collector station), and a water record needs a line or an outline from a public geometry source (NHD, TIGER/Line or a named OpenStreetMap way, ingest/waters_from_nhd.py HAND); none carries this water. Buildable once a public line exists or the record form takes a cited point.
rows.basis: the table's discharge location for two rows (dry weather Canyon Collector Transboundary Flow Events, 2026)
